title: Logarithmic dephasing resolves the phase and off-diagonal gates
question: Can ordinate oscillation and quadratic off-diagonal prime pairs be removed without discarding the RH-relevant horizontal zero data?

verdict.conclusion: Lift each prime--zero feature to a rank-one density operator and then average its conjugates under U_t e_n=exp(-it log n)e_n.  The resulting logarithmic twirl converges to the completely positive trace-preserving diagonal pinching map.  It keeps p_eta exactly and eliminates every n!=m entry instead of estimating the corresponding prime pair.  Eta is recoverable from two diagonal likelihoods; gamma can be retained in a separate classical register.  Thus the phase-removal and off-diagonal construction gates are resolved without Weil positivity or critical Chebyshev energy.  What remains is not construction but the RH-equivalent assertion that the actual global dephased mixture equals, or is uniformly bounded relative to, p_0.  No arithmetic theorem proving that assertion is obtained.
